summary: Apply form does not pre-select the student's active resume
found_by: Test execution run1: TC_UI_07 failed directly; TC_UI_11, 14, 15 and 37 failed with 'Select one of your active resumes.' and 10 later UI cases that depend on the application (TC_UI_12, 13, 17, 19-22, 35, 36, 38) could not run
description: UC-1 step 4 says the application form opens with the student's active resume pre-selected. The Resume list stays on '-- Select a resume --', so a student who confirms the form as shown gets 'Select one of your active resumes.' and no application is created. Cause: when the list is redrawn the page keeps the previous choice if it is still in the list, and the empty placeholder option always is, so the active resume was never chosen.
steps: Start the portal: python run.py and open http://127.0.0.1:8091/?role=student&id=101
In 'Apply for a job' choose J-1 Software Engineer
Look at the Resume field and press Submit application
expected: Resume shows Aarav_Resume_v2.pdf (the active one) and the application is submitted: 'Application submitted for J-1. Tracking id USPS-26-0001.' (FR-2.3, UC-1 step 4)
actual: Resume shows '-- Select a resume --'; Submit gives 'Select one of your active resumes.'
resolution: Fixed - fillApplyForm() keeps the previous resume only when one was actually chosen, otherwise it selects the student's active resume (app/static/app.js).
retest: TC_UI_07, TC_UI_11 and the 13 dependent UI cases PASS in run2 (151/151)

summary: Same job approval sent twice at once is applied twice and students are notified twice
found_by: Exploratory testing after run2 (double click / two officers); reproduced by new case TC_INT_10 in run3 (4 of 10 trials failed)
description: When two approval requests for the same pending posting arrive at the same moment, both pass the 'is it pending?' check before either saves the decision. Both get '200 published' and every eligible student receives the 'New job for you' notification twice. Cause: the decision reads the status and writes the new status without holding a lock.
steps: Start the portal with the demo data
Send 6 identical requests at the same time: POST /api/jobs/3/decision {decision: approve, actor_role: officer, actor_id: 1} (or double-click Record decision on a slow network)
Count the 200 responses and the student notifications about J-3
expected: Exactly one request succeeds, the others get '409: This job is not pending approval (status: published).'; each eligible student is notified once (FR-1.4)
actual: Two requests return 200 and each eligible student is notified twice (4 of 10 trials)
resolution: Fixed - decide_job() and resubmit_job() run under the application lock (threading.RLock), so check-and-update is atomic (app/server.py).
retest: TC_INT_10 PASS in run4: double decisions in 0 of 10 trials

summary: Same application status change sent twice at once is recorded twice
found_by: Exploratory testing after run2 (9 of 15 manual trials); reproduced by new case TC_INT_11 in run3 (3 of 10 trials failed)
description: If a recruiter's 'Move to review' request is sent twice at the same moment, both requests read the state Applied and both apply the transition, so the timeline shows the Applied -> Under Review step twice and the student gets two notifications. The same race exists for withdraw and offer responses.
steps: Send 8 identical requests at the same time: POST /api/applications/1/events {event: under_review, actor_role: recruiter, actor_id: 1}
Open GET /api/applications/1 and count the history entries
expected: One request succeeds; the others get '409: Event 'under_review' is not allowed when the application is Under Review.'; history has 2 entries (submit, under_review) (FR-2.5)
actual: Two or more requests return 200 and the history contains duplicate Under Review entries
resolution: Fixed - withdraw() and event() run under the same application lock as apply(); the lock is re-entrant because event() calls withdraw() (app/server.py).
retest: TC_INT_11 PASS in run4: double status changes in 0 of 10 trials

summary: Officer can approve a posting whose deadline has already passed
found_by: Exploratory testing after run2; reproduced by new case TC_M1_60 in run3
description: A posting that waited in the approval queue past its own deadline can still be approved. It is published as already Closed, and eligible students are told 'New job for you ... apply before <date in the past>', a job they can never apply to.
steps: Leave J-3 (deadline 20-11-2026 10:00) pending until the deadline
As Placement Officer choose J-3, Approve, Record decision
Look at the response, the student board and the student notifications
expected: '409: The deadline of J-3 has passed; return the posting so the recruiter can change it.' and J-3 stays pending (FR-1.4)
actual: '200: Job J-3 published. 1 eligible student(s) notified.'; J-3 shows as Closed on the board
resolution: Fixed - decide_job() refuses 'approve' when the deadline is not in the future; reject and return are still allowed (TC_M1_61) (app/server.py). Requirement FR-1.4 updated.
retest: TC_M1_60 and TC_M1_61 PASS in run4
